tools.name: list_builtin_functions
tools.description: Lists all available Zig builtin functions. Builtin functions are provided by the compiler and are prefixed with '@'. The comptime keyword on a parameter means that the parameter must be known at compile time. Use this to discover what functions are available, then use 'get_builtin_function' to get detailed documentation.

tools.name: get_builtin_function
tools.description: Search for Zig builtin functions by name and get their documentation, signatures, and usage information. Returns all matching functions ranked by relevance.

tools.name: search_std_lib
tools.description: Search the Zig standard library for functions, types, namespaces, and other declarations. Returns detailed markdown documentation for each matching item. Use this to explore the standard library and discover available functionality. Supports fuzzy matching and returns results ranked by relevance.

query.description: Search terms to find in the standard library (e.g., 'ArrayList', 'print', 'allocator', 'HashMap')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

tools.name: get_std_lib_item
tools.description: Get detailed documentation for a specific item in the Zig standard library. Provide the fully qualified name (e.g., 'std.ArrayList', 'std.debug.print', 'std.mem.Allocator') to get comprehensive documentation including function signatures, parameters, return types, error sets, example usage, and optionally source code.

name.description: Fully qualified name of the standard library item (e.g., 'std.ArrayList', 'std.debug.print', 'std.mem.Allocator')

get_source_file.description: Return the entire source file where this item is implemented (default: false - shows detailed documentation with item source code only)
